description:
This workflow shows Flexynesis usage for predicting survival markers from a multi-omics dataset

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Identifing Survival Markers of Brain tumor with Flexynesis](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/statistics/tutorials/flexynesis_survival/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)

* Includes a [Galaxy Workflow Report](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/galaxy/workflows_report_view.html)
